newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Urologix raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Urologix raised to buy.

text.p: -- Vector Securities International Inc said Monday it upgraded Urologix Inc to buy from attractive in light of recent pre-market regulatory approval of its T3 System for treating enlarged prostate disease.

-- Vector said last week's ruling by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration gives it confidence the Targeted Transurethral Thermo-ablation Therapy system is on track for final approval by the end of 1997 or early 1998.
-- The clinical results presented at the upcoming American Urological Association meeting are expected to be favorable to Urologix, Vector said.
-- Urologix develops treatments for urological disorders.
-- Its shares were up 3/8 Monday at 16-5/8.
